AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, in relation to request for

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2736

SPONSOR: COMRIE
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the general municipal law, in relation to request for
proposals and the addition of qualifications by municipalities

 
PURPOSE:

To provide municipalities with the ability to require contract terms on
municipal contracts.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends section 103 of the general municipal law to add a new
paragraph 17 to allow municipalities to adopt a local law so that
requests for proposals contain qualifications for bidders.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Currently, § 103 of the NY State General Municipal Law prevents munici-
palities across the state from including qualifications in municipal
contracts that must ultimately serve these areas. This keeps a munici-
pality from meeting its sustainability, social responsibility or other
preferences as reflected in local laws or ordinances when using their
funds to retain a contractor.

Municipalities should be able to consider local community issues, local
preference, worker rights, and simply responsible budgeting, in quali-
fications on RFPs for their own municipal contracts. This legislation
grants localities across the State the ability to include qualifications
in RFPs for contract bids.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

S5797 2022

S4357 COMRIE No Same as

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the State.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act would take effect immediately.
